About.heroSubtitle: Every recipe is a story. Share yours, and discover new flavors from homes around the world.
About.storyBody: Makubook exists for one simple reason: to connect through food from around the world. We're building a place where everyone can share food from their homes and be able to taste all the cuisines they wish to try. Now with no language barrier, you can discover a taste of the world without leaving the kitchen table.
About.step1Body: Write up a dish you love making, add a photo and tell people the story behind it.
About.step2Body: An editor reviews new recipes before they go live, just to keep things tidy and well presented.
About.step3Body: Your recipe joins the collection - saved, cooked, and commented on by people you've never met.
About.whyHeading: Everything you need to share & discover

About.ctaBody: It only takes a few minutes, and it might be someone's new favorite dish.
About.contactBody: Questions, feedback, or a recipe idea you want to see on Makubook? We'd love to hear from you.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.whoWeAreBodyPrefix: Makubook is a recipe-sharing platform based in Finland. For anything related to this privacy policy or your data, you can
Privacy.accountInfoBody: email address, password (stored securely, we never see it in plain text), display name, birthday, and an optional profile picture.
Privacy.contentBody: recipes you submit (title, description, ingredients, instructions, photos), comments and ratings you leave on other recipes.
Privacy.savedBody: which recipes you've saved — this list is private and only visible to you.
Privacy.whyBody: We use this data solely to run Makubook: creating and securing your account, letting you publish and manage recipes, showing your display name and avatar next to your contributions, and keeping track of the recipes you've saved. We do not sell your data or use it for advertising.
Privacy.whereBody: All data is stored with Supabase, our database and hosting provider, in a data center located in the EU (Stockholm, Sweden).
Privacy.cookiesBody: We use a small number of essential cookies to keep you logged in. We do not use tracking or advertising cookies.
Privacy.rightsBodyPrefix: Under GDPR, you have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data, and to request a copy of it. You can edit your display name and profile picture, and delete your own recipes and comments, directly in the app at any time. To request full deletion of your account and all associated data,
Privacy.changesBody: If this policy changes in a meaningful way, we'll update the date at the top of this page.
